notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed. The fake (fake.py) is a pure-Python contract stand-in for FloatingMiaGraspInsole-v0: no PyBullet, no soft-body, contact or force simulation, a placeholder terminal reward, zero force readings and a stationary object; it was never compared with an upstream run. The sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered environment, which needs the upstream package and pybullet/numpy/pytransform3d) was not run. Expected warnings left: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only arms the next reset, so there is no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for ticks, seed twice and action.values[*] (integer and array inputs the Gymnasium bridge derives; the action values are simulation offsets with no physical unit). There is no G4 warning. Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.step/reset/seed), so there are no catalogue requests. No site-limits.example.json is needed: the device is simulated R0 and no bound is operator_required. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
